name: manual_6cff80
claim: MCP singleton pattern: when N registrations point to the same server, run ONE backend daemon on a Unix socket and have each registration wrapper probe the socket, start the daemon (nohup, detached) if dead, then bridge its own stdio via Python threading. No socat dependency.

decisions.notes: Implemented for Exa MCP across 3 registrations (Claude Desktop, orama, PT). exa-mcp-daemon.py uses asyncio Unix socket server; wrappers use python threading for stdio<->socket bridge. Committed orama-system 600cda2, PT 0acbeba, 2026-07-04.
